rows.note: Use 膠紙 as the all-purpose word for adhesive tape.

example.english: The poster came off, so I used tape to stick it back on the wall.
example.traditional: 張海報甩咗，我用膠紙黐返上牆。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 lat1 zo2 ngo5 jung6 gaau1 zi2 ci1 faan1 soeng6 coeng4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that something is attached or bound with adhesive tape.

example.english: Use tape to attach the poster so the wind doesn't blow it away.
example.traditional: 用膠紙黐住張海報，唔好畀風吹走。
example.jyutping: jung6 gaau1 zi2 ci1 zyu6 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 m4 hou2 bei2 fung1 ceoi1 zau2

rows.note: Use this when recording spoken sound or other audio, including onto tape or another medium.

example.english: I want to tape the audio, so keep your voices down.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 luk6 jam1 nei5 dei6 sai3 seng1 di1

rows.note: Use this for tape containing an audio recording rather than video.

example.english: This tape is a recording my dad made when he was young.
example.traditional: 呢盒錄音帶係我阿爸後生嗰陣錄低嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 hap6 luk6 jam1 daai3 hai6 ngo5 aa3 baa1 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 luk6 dai1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for videotape or tape containing a video recording.

example.english: I still keep the video tape of me as a child.
example.traditional: 我仲留住細個嗰盒錄影帶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 lau4 zyu6 sai3 go3 go2 hap6 luk6 jing2 daai3
